bha_summary: 12-1/4" PDC Bit (Smith MDSi616) + Mud Motor + MWD/LWD (TeleScope/ecoScope) + 8" Drill Collars
operations_summary: Rotary drilled 12-1/4" hole from 1533 m to 1845 m MD with ROP averaging 28 m/hr. WOB: 12-15 tonnes, RPM: 120, SPP: 220 bar, Flow Rate: 3200 lpm. Formations drilled: Hordaland Group claystone. Mud losses: 0. Gas background: 0.4% C1.
remarks: Smooth drilling. Parameters optimized for vibration mitigation.

operations_summary: Drilled from 1845 m to 2180 m MD. Reached 9-5/8" casing setting depth at top of Rogaland Group. Pumped 15 m3 high-vis sweep, circulated hole clean with 2 bottoms up. Flow checked stable. Tripped out of hole to run casing.
remarks: Tight spot noted at 1920 m on trip out; reamed through with 50 kN overpull.

bha_summary: Running 9-5/8" Casing String (47# L-80 VAM TOP)
operations_summary: Rigged up casing handling equipment. Ran 168 joints of 9-5/8" 47# L-80 casing to 2175 m. Washed last 2 joints to bottom. Circulated casing volume. Cemented casing with 45 m3 lead cement (1.55 sg) and 18 m3 tail cement (1.90 sg). Bumped plug with 210 bar.
remarks: Cement returns to mudline confirmed. Floats holding.

bha_summary: 8-1/2" Rotary Steerable System (PowerDrive X5) + SonicScope + PeriScope
operations_summary: Drilled 8-1/2" section from 2640 m to 2780 m MD geosteering into Draupne Formation. Inc built from 58 deg to 72 deg with az 142 deg. ROP: 14 m/hr. Background gas increased to 2.1%.
remarks: Geosteering team active; navigating 2 m below top reservoir sand.

operations_summary: Drilled from 2780 m to 2910 m MD into Hugin reservoir sand. At 2890 m MD, encountered partial mud loss of 25 m3/hr. Reduced pump rate, spotted 10 m3 CaCO3 LCM pill. Losses cured. Reached planned TD for section at 2910 m MD (84.5 deg inc).
remarks: Excellent reservoir quality logged: porosity 22-26%, resistivity 120 ohm-m.

operations_summary: Drilled 17-1/2" top hole section from 830 m to 1250 m MD. Swept hole with 20 m3 high-vis pills every 100 m. ROP: 45 m/hr. Flow checked clean. Prepared to run 13-3/8" casing.
Drilled 8-1/2" horizontal reservoir section from 3300 m to 3410 m MD in Hugin formation (88 deg inclination). Average ROP: 12 m/hr. Real-time gamma ray showed continuous sand pay with oil shows.
remarks: Encountered intermittent MWD telemetry signal drop due to vibration at 3390 m.
